verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets built-in AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. They auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate complex cases to humans, so users hand alert triage to an in-product AI. The evidence is thin marketing copy, the agents are fixed-function workflow automation rather than an assistant you can give arbitrary tasks to, and on the Starter Plan their configuration cannot be customized. Missing for 10: a general-purpose or conversational assistant that accepts user-directed tasks, documentation of how users assign or control agent work, configurability beyond standardized agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
